newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Investcorp forecast to post record 96 net.
newsitem.headline: Investcorp forecast to post record 96 net.

text.p: International investment bank Investcorp is forecast to lift net profits 50 percent to a record $110 million in 1996 and pay a higher dividend, a research company said on Tuesday.
"We estimate Investcorp can safely declare a 50 percent increase in reported profit for 1996 at about $100 million to $110 million," Securities & Investment Research Co said.
"This will make it the most profitable company on the Bahrain Stock Exchange."
It said increased dividends were also on the cards, thanks to improved 1996 performance.
"(Investcorp) management has been in the past reluctant to increase dividends in order to finance growth internally as much as possible," the research company said.
"After the substantial effective increase in cashflow for 1996, the shareholders are generally expecting to receive increased distributions."
It said the reason for Investcorp's improved outlook was its successful sales of companies this year. Last year the company posted a previous record net profit of $70.3 million.

Founded in 1982, Bahrain-based Investcorp has a knack for picking up poorly-performing and sometimes sick companies at a bargain, injecting capital and restructuring their debt before selling them off, often at a fat margin.
